title: PPT Master: AI that makes a real PowerPoint
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-10: github.com/hugohe3/ppt-master (README: AI generates native PowerPoint from any document; MIT; 59,115 stars; a skill that runs in any agent-capable tool (Claude Code recommended; Cursor, Codex, Copilot...); 'Please turn the following into a PPT'; the AI first confirms the design spec (template, PPT 16:9, 8-10 pages); reasons the argument into shape first, then designs; output is natively editable DrawingML .pptx with slide masters, native shapes, charts and tables (editable shapes by default, --native-charts-and-tables for data-backed Chart/Table objects with Edit Data); distils templates from references; fills an existing .pptx preserving its design; adds native transitions, animations and narration; free and open source, the only cost is the AI model; data stays local apart from model calls; Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi; 'This is a tool, not a wishing well'; cheaper models need more polishing; built by Hugo He, a finance professional who wanted AI slides to stay editable). Narration: Chatterbox (MIT) on the laptop's CPU.
